snp2.3:1.1:
One who,
flouting, despising
a sense of shame,
snp2.3:1.3:
but not grasping
what he could do [to help]:
snp2.3:1.4:
Know him as
“Not one of mine.”
snp2.3:2.1:
One who,
among friends,
speaks endearing words
snp2.3:3.1:
He’s not a friend
who’s always wary,
snp2.3:3.2:
suspecting a split,
focusing just on your weakness.
snp2.3:3.3:
But him on whom you can depend,
like a child on its parent’s breast:
snp2.3:3.4:
That’s a true friend
whom others can’t split from you.
snp2.3:4.3: the conditions that make for joy,
snp2.3:5.3:
one is freed from evil, devoid
of distress,
snp2.3:5.4:
refreshed with the savor
of rapture in the Dhamma.
